title: State Commission must transfer complaint
description: transfer complaint pending before a District Commission to another District Commission

content.what: may transfer any complaint pending before a District Commission to another District Commission within the State
conditions: if the interest of justice so requires
limitations: at any stage of the proceeding
on the application of the complainant or of its own motion
